title: Unit Event — Popping in My Heart! — Episode7 One Big Dream First, Together

meta.Episode: Episode7 — One Big Dream First, Together
meta.Event Outline: Emu takes part in a discussion with her brothers regarding future operations of the park. However, each idea she puts forth comes up against issues of feasibility, leaving her determined to educate herself. That's when she gets the news of an opportunity to visit Mr. Riley's park...

rows.Line: Riley Dream Park
“Smiley” area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It seems pretty ordinary, you know...?
The merry-go-round's about the only thing that really sort of stands out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That merry-go-round...
It's like something Grandpa made!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your grandfather?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's so warm and comfy...
And makes me wanna smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Just like with the Wonder Stage.
It always feels like he's right there with us.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Hehe. Good eye, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Truth be told, your grandfather, Rakunosuke, and I worked together on “Smiley”, the very movie that this area is based off of.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: The first time we met must've been twenty years ago...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I originally aspired to become an actor, but that didn't end up working out...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: However, I still wanted to be involved in the entertainment industry, so I joined a film production company.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I spent years and years working my way up the ladder, and finally received a chance to produce my very first film.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I was looking forward to making something that could bring smiles and joy to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Why...?
It always turns out so plain...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: We had the budget, stayed on schedule and hired an excellent staff. On paper, nothing could've gone wrong...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
And yet...
We have to start over from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
No...!
Our deadline's right around the corner, but it's still not good enough...!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
What am I supposed to do...?
We had a massive budget, but having to redo everything's already put us over...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: I just wanted to produce a movie with the same sort of wonderment that I saw growing up... Why can't I just do that...?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line:
Hello, Jean.
Your current project seems to be giving you quite a bit of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Oh, it's you...
I heard that you've been doing very well for yourself as a director.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
While I'm up a creek...
I had the perfect plan for producing this movie, but it's all gone to waste.

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line:
I see...
What if you hired a consultant?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: A consultant?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: Yes, everyone's been talking about this genius who gives people just the advice they need.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: I see... Can you tell me more about this person?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: Not much more than him being an elderly Japanese man. Apparently, he gives out the perfect advice if he enjoys what he sees.

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: A friend of mine should be able to get a hold of him... What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: An elderly Japanese man...?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (I can't say that I have high expectations, but it's better than doing nothing at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Alright...
Mind setting us up?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: Great. I'll get right on it!
One week later

Hello there!
Thank you for asking to see me!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you. My name is Jean Riley... And you are...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Jean! I'm Rakunosuke!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But enough of that! Let's see this movie of yours! I can't wait to have a look at what you have for me!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (He seems awfully childish for someone his age.)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (Is this really the consultant he was talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I'd like to hear what you thought about it.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
What do you think needs work?
Suggestions that keep us within budget and on schedule would be ideal.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Well... If I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: This movie... It requires more wonderment!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Is this all your imagination can muster, Jean?! There must be more dreams and ideas in that head of yours!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Um... What do you mean by that exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: For example, take the opening!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: The place where the main character, Smiley, lives is supposed to be an “island paradise” that's full of dreams and smiles, right?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: That means you should present it as such! More glitz! More glam! More fun! More excitement! Am I wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I see...
But...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Again, this needs more and more wonderment!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: I mean, are you satisfied with the island's denizens being computer generated?! You wanted to show people in a state of pure bliss, no?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Yes, we originally planned on hiring extras...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: I knew it! How about we hire a thousand?!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
A... A thousand?!
But we don't have the time or resources to hire extras...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Anything goes when you're making a masterpiece! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
(Wh-What's he talking about...?!
We can't all have what we wish for!)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (Still, he's supposed to be some sort of genius. What if he's right? What if there is some grand plan behind all his talk...?)

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Alright, Jean!
Let me hear more about your dreams!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Hmm... This scene needs to be spiced up a little more. What if you made a set with an actual castle?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
A castle?!
You're right that I initially hoped to have a castle made of white stone... But still...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Ah, if this is what you call a climax, then you're going to leave a sour taste in everyone's mouths...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Jean, there must've been more that you wanted to do here! Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: What's this? This looks like a list of ideas. It even mentions your island paradise crumbling apart!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
What a spectacular idea!
This is what you should be doing instead!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And the ending needs to be full of glee and joy! By doing so, you'll have a wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: No... I've had enough...!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: You've been going on and on about wonderment and dreams, but we're trying to run a business here! We have a schedule and budget to think about!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Yes, I want to make all these things happen! I want the world to see all of my ideas come to life!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: But reality just isn't that kind!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
You have your head in the clouds...
You call yourself an adult...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Yes, I'm very much an adult.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And my family does often call me childish.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: If you understand that, then...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Is it wrong for us to have dreams?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: This is what I tell people.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Only those who dream big can give others a sense of wonderment.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So let's start by dreaming big again, Jean.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Yes, reality's a harsh mistress, and she'll be waiting for you to wake up from your dream.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But believing in your dreams and feeling that sense of wonderment will help keep that at bay. At least, that's what I think.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So how about it? Feel like dreaming big, together?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Dreaming big, together...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: To be fair, I've been doing this a lot longer than you have, so I'm used to dealing with reality's cruel tricks.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But I'll be more than willing to help with schedule changes and such, so feel free to ask me for anything.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Despite how I look, I have some friends in high places.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
So let's just start with your dream.
Worry about the consequences later.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
What do you say, Jean?
Can you show me what your dreams are made of?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And when we do have to come back down to Earth, we can work through that together.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Rakunosuke...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (My dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (He's right about me placing reality above my aspirations. I'd nearly forgotten all about them.)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (No wonder things weren't going well...)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Thank you, Rakunosuke...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: You're right. It's high time I started dreaming again.
